description: Four sample players with a mixer. Each slot loads a wav or aiff file, plays it at a speed and level you set, and the four are summed to a stereo pair

params.text: Puts that slot in gate mode, playing only while its trigger input is high
Puts that slot in one shot mode, playing the sample through once for each trigger
The playback speed of that slot
Where that slot is placed between the left and right outputs
Scales the CV changing that slot's playback speed
The level of the chain inputs going into the mixer

inputs.text: A CV changing that slot's playback speed
A pulse starts that slot playing
A pulse stops that slot playing
One of the two chain inputs, mixed into the outputs so that several of these can be chained

outputs.text: That slot's own output, taken before the mixer
The left output of the mixer, carrying the four slots at their set levels and positions
The right output of the mixer, carrying the four slots at their set levels and positions
A pulse when that slot reaches the end of its sample

notes: a slot is silent until a file is loaded into it; drop an audio file onto the module or use that slot's Open WAV or AIFF File item on the menu
menu: Open WAV or AIFF File SLOT 1 ... — loads a wav or aiff file into that slot; the menu carries one such item per slot, numbered 1 to 4
Exclude Connected SAMPLES from MIX — keeps a slot whose own output is patched out of the mixer
DECLICK ON START — fades the start of a sample in over 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 or 1000 samples, or Declick on start DISABLED for none
Can Use Negative FM CV — lets the speed CV go below zero
Autoplay on LOAD — starts a slot playing as soon as a file is loaded into it
